dataset: Peru primary education enrollment and GDP per capita, 2001–2020

sources.description: GDP per capita, current US dollars

columns.name: Primary Enrollment
columns.meaning: Number of pupils enrolled in primary education in Peru

columns.name: GDP per Capita (Current US$)
columns.meaning: GDP per person, measured in current U.S. dollars

cleaning: Filtered by country and indicator codes, reshaped yearly values, converted to numeric, checked missing values, rounded GDP per capita to 2 decimals, and exported as CSV and SQLite.
limitations: Pupil counts are not enrollment rates; current-dollar GDP is not inflation-adjusted; trends are descriptive and do not establish causality.
